description: This file defines a PHP class TerminationReasonConfigurationSearchFilterParams, which extends a base FilterParams class. It is used for specifying search filter parameters related to termination reasons in the OrangeHRM platform. The class primarily sets default sort field behavior.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for search filter parameters specific to termination reason configurations in the PIM module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'tr.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the object and sets the default sort field for termination reason configurations.
